info.title: APITCG
info.description:
Welcome to **API TCG**. The purpose of this API is to expose the card and product data of each TCG: games, sets/expansions, products (cards, sealed, accessories) and price history. ![API TCG](./intro.png) ## Authentication All data endpoints require an **API key**. Getting one is free: 1. Create an account at [apitcg.com/register](https://apitcg.com/register) (or sign in at [apitcg.com/login](https://apitcg.com/login)). 2. Open the [Developer Platform](https://apitcg.com/platform) and go to **[API Key](https://apitcg.com/platform/api-key)** — your key is shown there. 3. Send it in the `x-api-key` header on every request: ```bash curl 'https://api.apitcg.com/api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy' \ -H 'x-api-key: YOUR_API_KEY' ``` JavaScript example: ```js const res = await fetch( 'https://api.apitcg.com/api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy', { headers: { 'x-api-key': process.env.APITCG_API_KEY } } ); const body = await res.json(); ``` You can paste your key in the **Authentication** panel of this documentation to try endpoints live. Keep your API key secret. If you think it was exposed, write to [support@apitcg.com](mailto:support@apitcg.com). ### Authentication errors | Status | Meaning | |--------|---------| | `401 Unauthorized` | Missing or invalid API key. | | `429 Too Many Requests` | Too many requests. | ## Available TCGs | Name | Slug | |------|------| | Cardfight Vanguard | `cardfight-vanguard` | | Digimon | `digimon` | | Dragon Ball Super Fusion World | `dragon-ball-super-fusion-world` | | Dragon Ball Super Masters | `dragon-ball-super-masters` | | Flesh and Blood | `flesh-and-blood` | | Gundam | `gundam` | | hololive | `hololive` | | Lorcana | `lorcana` | | Magic | `magic` | | Mitos y Leyendas | `mitos-y-leyendas` | | One Piece | `one-piece` | | Pokémon | `pokemon` | | Riftbound | `riftbound` | | Star Wars Unlimited | `star-wars-unlimited` | | Union Arena | `union-arena` | | Yu-Gi-Oh | `yugioh` | Use the **slug** as the `{tcg}` value in the routes (e.g. `/api/one-piece/sets`) and in the `?tcg=` filter for products. ## How to use Search products by combining filters, for example: ``` GET /api/products?tcg=one-piece&type=card&name=luffy ``` The `tcg` and `set` references come back as **full documents**, not as IDs — you do not need `populate` for them. The slug/ID of each one is its `_id`. ## Product attributes Apart from the fixed fields (`name`, `images`, `markets`…), every product carries an `attributes` object: a map of strings whose **keys depend on the game**. A Lorcana card has `Cost Ink` and `Lore Value`; a Magic card has `OracleText`, `P` and `T`. Values may contain light HTML (``, ``, `
`), because that is how the source publishes them. Two keys are worth calling out: - **`Artist`** — on a `card`, the illustrator of the card. - **`Description`** — on a `card`, its rules text; on a `sealed` product, the description of the product (what the box contains, print run notes, etc.). ### Artist `attributes.Artist` holds the illustrator of the card. It is filled in progressively, so **not every card has it**: - **Games that publish the artist:** `digimon`, `flesh-and-blood`, `gundam`, `lorcana`, `magic`, `one-piece`, `pokemon`, `riftbound`, `star-wars-unlimited`. - **Games that do not publish it:** `cardfight-vanguard`, `dragon-ball-super-fusion-world`, `dragon-ball-super-masters`, `hololive`, `mitos-y-leyendas`, `union-arena`, `yugioh`. Even in the games that do publish it the coverage is not 100% (in `pokemon` and `gundam` it sits above half the catalog), so treat `Artist` as an optional key: check for it before reading it. There is no `?artist=` filter — the field travels inside `attributes`. ### Sealed product descriptions `attributes.Description` on a `type: "sealed"` product is the description of the sealed product itself. Most of the sealed catalog already has it: ``` GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&type=sealed&limit=1 ``` ```json { "_id": 50733, "type": "sealed", "name": "10th Movie Commemoration Set", "attributes": { "Description": "To commemorate the 10th Pokémon movie release in Japan, a special card album was released containing 11 cards…" } } ``` ## Pagination - `limit` — number of results per query (maximum `100`, default `25`). - `page` — the page you want to show of the total results. Example: `/api/products?tcg=pokemon&name=charizard&limit=50&page=2` ## Showcase List of websites people are building with API TCG: 1. [tcgmatch.cl](https://tcgmatch.cl) 2. [Search Piece](https://search-piece.vercel.app/) Want to add your site? Open a pull request on [docs.apitcg.com](https://github.com/apitcg/docs.apitcg.com). ## Questions If you have any questions, you can write to: [support@apitcg.com](mailto:support@apitcg.com)

get.description:
Returns products with combinable filters. If you search by `name` and there is no exact match, a partial fallback search kicks in and the response includes `fallback: true`.

The `tcg` and `set` references always come back as **full documents** — you do not need `populate` for them.

### Examples

- Search cards by name:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=one-piece&name=luffy
```

- Search by card code:

```
GET /api/products?code=OP03-070
```

- Cards of a TCG with pagination and sorting:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=pokemon&type=card&name=charizard&limit=50&page=2
```

- Sealed products of a TCG (their description travels in `attributes.Description`):

```
GET /api/products?tcg=riftbound&type=sealed
```

- The illustrator of a card is in `attributes.Artist`, when the game publishes it:

```
GET /api/products?tcg=lorcana&type=card&name=elsa
```

See [Product attributes](#description/product-attributes) for what `attributes` carries.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: Filter by product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products.

parameters.name: tcg
parameters.description: Filter by TCG (slug — see the list of available TCGs).

parameters.name: serie
parameters.description: Filter by series (series ID). Series are not in use in the current catalog.

parameters.name: updatedSince
parameters.description: Only products updated since this date (ISO 8601).

parameters.name: populate
parameters.description: Comma-separated references to include as full documents. Allowed values: `tcg`, `set`, `serie`. `tcg` and `set` already come populated by default, so in practice you only need this for `serie`.

fallback.description: Present and `true` only when the partial name fallback search was used.

TCG.description: Trading card game. The `_id` is a slug generated from the name.

Set.description: Set/expansion within a TCG. The `_id` is composed as `{tcg}-{slug}`.

tcg.description: Slug of the TCG it belongs to (or the full document when using `populate=tcg`).

serie.description: ID of the series it belongs to (optional).

Product.description: Product resource. Fields marked (Card), (Sealed) or (Accessory) only apply to that product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products; fields marked _(not in use)_ exist in the model but the catalog does not fill them today.

type.description: Product type. The catalog currently holds `card` and `sealed` products.

description.description: Top-level product description _(not in use)_. The description of a sealed product travels in `attributes.Description`.

tcg.description: TCG the product belongs to. The API returns the **full document**; its `_id` is the slug (e.g. `one-piece`).

serie.description: Series ID (or the full document with `populate=serie`) _(not in use)_.

set.description: Set the product belongs to. The API returns the **full document**; its `_id` is the set ID (e.g. `one-piece-pillars-of-strength`). Absent or `null` when the product is not linked to a set.

dimensions.description: Physical dimensions of the product _(not in use)_.

release_date.description: Release date of the product _(not in use)_. The release date of the set is in `set.release_date`.

markets.description: Product data and IDs on external markets.

cardNumber.description: (Card) Card number within the set _(not in use)_. The number travels in `attributes.Number`.

attributes.description:
Dynamic attributes of the product. The keys depend on the game (see [Product attributes](#description/product-attributes)); values may contain light HTML.

- **(Card)** `Artist` — illustrator of the card, when the game publishes it.
- **(Card)** `Description` — the rules text of the card.
- **(Sealed)** `Description` — the description of the sealed product.

HistoryPrice.description: Daily price record of a product across markets.
